an7.25:1.1: Satta vo bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi . . .
an7.25:1.3: Katame ca bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
an7.25:1.4: Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhū saddhā bhavissanti, vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.25:2.1: Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhū hirimanto bhavissanti . . .
an7.25:2.6: paññavanto bhavissanti, vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.25:3.1: Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī
